system.description: For the duration of this spell, normal fire and heat cannot harm the spell's recipient. The recipient also gains a +2 bonus on all saving throws against magical fire (dragon's breath, fireball, etc.). Furthermore, damage from such fire is reduced by 1 point per die of damage (though each die will inflict at least 1 point of damage, regardless of adjustments). Red dragon breath damage is reduced by 1 point per Hit Die of the creature (again, to no less than 1 point of damage per Hit Die).
